summary: Interactive Brokers Group filed an 8-K on July 31, 2026, announcing a prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) to register up to 920,000 shares of its Class A common stock from its existing Form S-3 shelf. The shares will be used for promotions to attract new customers. Dechert LLP provided the legal opinion. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
